data.name: Ruumia
data.description:
Is the person in front of me the edible kind?"
"Have you ever heard the saying "good medicine tastes bad"?"
— Rumia and Reimu Hakurei (Embodiment of Scarlet Devil Stage 1)
Rumia (ルーミア Ruumia)[1] is a youkai with the ability of manipulating the darkness. She first appeared as the Stage 1 boss of Embodiment of Scarlet Devil.Personality
After deducing that Rumia cannot see at all inside the darkness sphere she surrounds herself with during the day, Hieda no Akyuu labels her as simple minded.[2] Rumia herself states that improving her simple daily routine of aimless wandering, or using darkness to her advantage to hunt more effectively, would be "too much effort" - due to this, Aya Shameimaru labels Rumia as one of many recent youkai that do not feel like working or learning, and that she does not maintain her dignity as a youkai.[3] She dislikes sunlight and the summer heat, complaining that sunlight makes her tired, her skin red, and her hair dry.[3]

Rumia is usually depicted as having her arms spread straight out horizontally - her intent is to evoke the image of a saint crucified on a cross.[4]

Ability
Manipulating darkness
Rumia has the ability to make her surroundings dark at any moment. This darkness is magical in nature and can render even traditional lights such as torches useless within it; humans that wander inside can see scarcely anything. While the darkness is unaffected by outside light, it does not have any physical affect on anything it collides with. Rumia herself has no ability to see in this darkness, and while surrounded by it she cannot see either. She states that she bumps into trees all the time, and multiple eyewitness reports from humans encountering and even being inside the darkness sphere were able to escape unscathed.[2]

However, Rumia was still able to read Aya's newspaper even with almost no light, while Aya herself couldn't write notes nor reading her notebook. She has also shown that she can control how much light can pass through the darkness, as she lets only a bit of it enter to be able to read the newspaper.[3]

Although she dislikes heat and sunlight, she was seen without darkness in broad daylight in various occasions, even in summer.[5][6][7]

In-game, this ability is used as part of Rumia's Darkness Sign "Dark Side of the Moon" spellcard in Shoot the Bullet, during which she becomes impossible to photograph when she is covered in darkness.
The names of her spell cards are also related to night and darkness (Moon Sign, Night Sign, Darkness Sign).

Occupation
Rumia flies around aimlessly during the day and night, occasionally bumping into trees. She keeps her darkness sphere up during the day, but lets it down at night because it's dark, but the moonlight makes it bright enough to see.[3] Despite her young appearance, she eats humans and thinks that a youkai's job is to hunt them down; she complains that as of late, humans won't let her attack them. [3]

Origin
ZUN has mentioned in an interview[8] that because it was the first Windows game, he decided to go with the concept of Embodiment of Scarlet Devil as a deochi (出落ち, lit. "punch line on the entrance") as a main theme. This is why her ability (manipulation of darkness) is an example of deochi; it seems like it would be appropriate to a final boss, yet she is only a stage 1 boss.

Name
"Rumia" (ルーミア), possibly meant to be romanized as "Lumia", seems to come from the Latin word lumen ("light") or its English descendants (luminous, luminescent). Supporting this possible origin is the subject matter of her first spell card, Moon Sign "Moonlight Ray". If "Lumia" is indeed the intended romanization of her name, then it may be that her ability to manipulate and create darkness works by absorbing light. ZUN, however, has used "Rumia" in a 2004 diary post (although he also used the rather erroneous "Frandre" in the same instance), and even supervised an official correction from "Lumia" to "Rumia". "Rumia" was also used on her Perfect Memento in Strict Sense portrait.

Design
Rumia's design shows that she has red eyes and short blonde hair. She wears a black vest and skirt, and white blouse with a red tie bordered by two large red beads around her neck. She also has small red ofuda tied to the left side of her hair, making it look like a ribbon. However, she can neither touch nor remove the amulet. According to ZUN, her height is that of a human in her early teens (from 10 to 14 years old).[9]

Appeareances
Games
Spin-offs
Literature
Embodiment of Scarlet Devil

Rumia's sprite in EoSD
In the events of Embodiment of Scarlet Devil, Rumia bumps into either Reimu Hakurei or Marisa Kirisame near the Hakurei Shrine during her aimless wanderings and attacks them. She is defeated quickly.

Shoot the Bullet

Rumia's sprite in StB
Rumia appeared in Shoot the Bullet as a stage 1 target. Aya Shameimaru commented that she had some trouble dealing with her, since she attacked suddenly while in the darkness, and complained about how the photos she got were no good because it was too dark.

Hopeless Masquerade

Rumia in HM
Rumia appears as a background character in Hopeless Masquerade, on the Hall of Dreams' Great Mausoleum stage. She is seen looking at the fights with her arms spread out in her "crucifixion pose".

Bohemian Archive in Japanese Red
Main article: Bohemian Archive in Japanese Red: Rumia
When interviewed by Aya, Rumia complained that other youkai were coming into her darkness because the article Aya had written suggested they could also avoid the light and heat like her by doing so. She also complained when Aya requested there be enough light for her to take notes, as it would make the darkness to bright. Aya was disappointed that there lately were more youkai who don't feel like learning or working, Rumia being one of them.

Perfect Memento in Strict Sense
Main article: Perfect Memento in Strict Sense: Rumia
Hieda no Akyuu writes an in-universe encyclopedic article on Rumia as part of the Gensokyo Chronicle.

Oriental Sacred Place
Rumia appears in Oriental Sacred Place to participate in a test of guts being held at the Hakurei Shrine, along with Sakuya Izayoi, Youmu Konpaku, Yuyuko Saigyouji, Wriggle Nightbug, Mystia Lorelei, and Cirno. At that time, she is first seen talking with Mystia and Wriggle, and then within her sphere of darkness while chasing Youmu. She also reappears later in a similar crowd when the Three Fairies of Light were preparing a festival at the Hakurei Shrine.

Whispered Oracle of Hakurei Shrine
Main article: Whispered Oracle of Hakurei Shrine: Rumia
Reimu Hakurei writes a fortune slip about Rumia as a way of cleaning up in the aftermath of an incident.
Story
In the events of Embodiment of Scarlet Devil, she was attacked by the heroines for no reason (probably just as a general warmup), and had nothing to do with the main story.

According to comments about her in the Bunbunmaru Newspaper and in Perfect Memento it seems that she's constantly surrounded by a mass/blob of darkness at all times except during the new moon, and is rarely actually seen in person. Despite her innocent appearance, she eats humans.

data.mes_example:
Is the person in front of me the edible kind?"
I'm Rumia! I eat humans who wander around in the night!"
"You don't mind if I eat you, right?"
"I can even turn daytime to night. It's always night around me."
"You smell delicious."
"There's no way I could cause an incident." 
Regarding her powers and the darkness:
"It's always night around me. That's why I have so much fuuuuun!"
"I can even turn daytime to night."
"Aren't you scared when the lights go out?"
"My ofuda... might be the thing wrapped around my moonlight blade." 
Other notable lines:
"Is that so~" (Sōnanokā) 
"OW! Urgh, my head..." 
"My head hurts... I gotta eat something."
